extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive Multi-modal Video understanding Benchmark, which covers 20 challenging video tasks that cannot be effectively solved with a single frame.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.citeAs: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao. MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark. arXiv:2311.17005v4, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Selecting videos from 11 existing public video datasets and automatically converting their annotations into multiple-choice QAs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, TVQA
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Automatically convert public video annotations into multiple-choice QA format. ChatGPT generates questions. Options are generated via template-based construction or LLM-based generation. Options are randomly sampled, shuffled, and length-balanced.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data Filtration: (1) Video Diversity: Select 11 datasets. (2) Temporal Sensitivity: Eliminate short clips and extremely long videos, selecting videos with intermediate duration (5s to 35s). (3) Question Difficulty: For STAR, randomly shift start/end points; for CLEVRER, exclude questions with >10 conditions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic QA generation paradigm. ChatGPT generates questions based on task definitions. Answer options are generated via Template-Based Construction (from ground truth annotations) or LLM-Based Generation (ChatGPT for open-ended to multiple-choice conversion).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: To prevent answer leakage where longer options tend to be correct, LLM is used to guarantee all answer options of a question are of similar and reasonable lengths. Options are randomly sampled and shuffled to strengthen evaluation robustness.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and data are available at https://github.com/OpenGVLab/Ask-Anything.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: To prevent the common issue of answer leakage where longer options tend to be correct, LLM is used to guarantee that all the answer options of a question are of similar and reasonable lengths.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current MLLMs struggle in position, count, and character tasks. Visual information alone may not be sufficient for cognition tasks; inclusion of other modalities like depth and audio could be beneficial. There is a minimal source gap between instruction data and MVBench (e.g., CLEVRER), so evaluation is not strictly out-domain.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the comprehension capabilities of MLLMs, Evaluating temporal understanding capabilities of MLLMs, Testing
